native_result.HypoA: The original studies in Experimental Economics were primarily conducted in the United States (61.1%), while the replication studies were more distributed across countries like Austria (27.8%), Germany (11.1%), Singapore (27.8%), the United Kingdom (11.1%), and the United States (22.2%).
native_result.HypoB: Approximately 5.6% (1 of 18) of the original studies in the Experimental Economics replication project were conducted in the United Kingdom. All 18 EE original studies have a recorded experiment country (none missing), so the denominator is unambiguous: 1/18 = 0.0556 ≈ 5.56%.
